botcomponent.description: Runs the Accounts Payable three-way match on retrieved Invoice, PO and GR data. It checks existence, mandatory fields, quantity, unit price, total amount and vendor, detects exceptions such as duplicates, reversals, over-receipts and partial receipts, and classifies each invoice as Matched, Exception or Error by critical-issue priority. Use it after the data is retrieved, or when the user asks about the matching rules.
botcomponent.name: three-way-match-validation
